name: R008-machamp-revenge-asleep
why: Challenge 7. The opponent leads Machamp (set 811: Revenge, Rock Slide, Facade, Counter). The player leads Lapras (set 822: Sheer Cold, Horn Drill, Rest, Sleep Talk; Leppa Berry, no Chesto) and uses Rest every turn: it fails while Lapras is at full HP, and works as soon as Machamp has hit it once. Lapras then sleeps two turns (Rest again while asleep does nothing; after waking it rests again). Every AI turn while Lapras is asleep, AI_CV_Revenge scores -2 without a roll, the runCvRevenge status block. Lapras is bulky (226 HP), so it survives the hits before the first Rest.
